caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular sheet of paper that is bordered with a thin, double-lined frame and filled with carefully arranged German calligraphic writing divided into several sections by red and brown ruling lines. The largest and most prominent section is at the top and contains ornate, Gothic-style script in large letters, with the first word starting with an exaggeratedly large and decorative “D” in alternating shades of red, blue, and gold, while the rest of the letters follow in a similar multi-colored manner. Beneath this, there is a line of smaller, but still elaborate, black calligraphy, followed by a line of red cursive script. The composition is divided vertically and horizontally to create several compartments, each filled with dense handwritten text in German, executed in a mixture of faded black and sepia ink. The lower portion includes examples of script alphabets, with capital and lowercase letters written out in rows. The text along the left and right sides is written in a diagonal, vertical, or nearly vertical orientation. The background of the sheet is a light tan, and the overall color palette includes brown, red, blue, gold, and black ink. There is a small ink signature or inscription near the bottom right corner of the sheet, just outside the inner frame. The paper displays light staining and aging.
title: Fractur (Illuminated Writing)
